findings.description: The bucket has no acl set explicitly and is commented as public with no bucket-level public access block, allowing unauthorized read/write access to potentially sensitive data.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects stored in this bucket are not encrypted at rest by default.
Versioning is not enabled, meaning accidental or malicious deletion/overwrite of objects (including the customer master file) cannot be recovered, increasing impact of a compromise.

findings.issue_category: sensitive data in unencrypted public bucket
findings.description: A customer master data file is stored in aws_s3_bucket.data, which is public and unencrypted, directly exposing sensitive customer data to unauthorized access.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this financials bucket, leaving sensitive financial data unencrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined, so stored operational data is not encrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined, so stored data science data is not encrypted at rest.
